# Coreball Online

> Coreball Online is a free browser game: you fire pins from the bottom of the screen into a small rotating core, and you must not touch the pins that are already inserted. 500 fixed, reproducible levels. No account, no download, no plugin. English at / and Japanese (まち針ゲーム) at /ja/.

## Key facts

- Game type: single-player browser arcade/timing game rendered with the HTML5 canvas element.
- Levels: 500, each with a fixed layout (deterministic per level number).
- Controls: mouse click, touch tap, or Space/Enter. P pauses, R restarts.
- Fail state: touching an existing pin ends the run; tapping the screen restarts the same level instantly.
- Progress: the highest unlocked level and the sound setting are stored locally in the browser (localStorage). There are no accounts and no server-side profiles.
- Languages: English (/) and Japanese (/ja/) on separate URLs with reciprocal hreflang.
- Advertising: Google AdSense slots only, placed outside the game area.
- Independence: this is an independent fan-made game inspired by classic Coreball-style gameplay and is not affiliated with any original publisher.
